evals.prompt: Expose a pets table through the generic CRUD layer so the web can list a user's own pets with their owner joined, filtered by species and sorted by name.
evals.expected_output: Adds the table and relations in packages/db, registers a zod-only `pets` resource in crud.resources.ts (select/create without server-managed fields, filterable/sortable allowlists, owner relation to users), binds it in crud.tables.ts, adds a scope + beforeCreate policy on ownerId, and shows orpc.crud.list.queryOptions usage; api-contract stays free of drizzle and @petshop/db imports.

evals.prompt: Make it possible for the client to filter pets by ownerId and import the pets table into crud.resources.ts so the schema comes from drizzle.
evals.expected_output: Pushes back on importing tables into api-contract (it must stay zod-only; the binding in crud.tables.ts type-checks drift) and explains that filtering by ownerId is unnecessary because the policy scope already restricts rows; only adds ownerId to filterable if there is a real cross-owner use case.

evals.prompt: Orders need payment capture and stock reservation when created. Add them to orpc.crud.
evals.expected_output: Recommends a dedicated feature contract/service/controller (orpc-api-contract + petshop-server) instead of the generic CRUD layer, because the operation has business rules and side effects; at most exposes read-only list/get for orders via CRUD.
